def-sample-covariance-directional-spectr:
## Definition

For positive integers $d,N$, let $X\in\mathbb C^{d\times N}$ and let $T\in\mathbb C^{d\times d}$ be Hermitian positive semidefinite, meaning $T=T^*$ and $v^*Tv\ge0$ for every $v\in\mathbb C^d$. Let $T^{1/2}$ be its Hermitian positive semidefinite square root and set
$$A:=\frac1N T^{1/2}XX^*T^{1/2}.$$
For each distinct eigenvalue $\lambda$ of the Hermitian matrix $A$, let $P_\lambda$ be the orthogonal projection onto its eigenspace. The empirical spectral distribution of $A$, normalized by its dimension $d$, is
$$\mu_A:=\frac1d\sum_{\lambda\in\operatorname{spec}(A)}\operatorname{rank}(P_\lambda)\,\delta_\lambda,$$
where $\delta_\lambda$ is the unit point mass at $\lambda$.
For a deterministic unit vector $x\in\mathbb C^d$, its directional spectral measure is
$$\mu_A^x:=\sum_{\lambda\in\operatorname{spec}(A)}\|P_\lambda x\|_2^2\,\delta_\lambda.$$
For a Borel set $B\subseteq\mathbb R$, set $\mathbf1_B(A):=\sum_{\lambda\in B\cap\operatorname{spec}(A)}P_\lambda$; then $\mu_A^x(B)=x^*\mathbf1_B(A)x$. Both measures are supported on the nonnegative real axis.
lem-bounded-complex-iid-matrix-norm-boun:
## Statement

For each positive integer $n$, let $N_n$ be a positive integer with $n/N_n\to c\in(0,\infty)$, and let $X_n\in\mathbb C^{n\times N_n}$ have independent identically distributed entries $\xi$ satisfying $\mathbb E\xi=0$ and $|\xi|\le K$ almost surely for a fixed $K<\infty$. Then there is a finite constant $C=C(K,c)$ such that, almost surely, $\|X_n\|_{\mathrm{op}}\le C\sqrt{N_n}$ for all sufficiently large $n$.
lem-complex-quadratic-form-fourth-moment:
## Statement

Let $\xi=(\xi_1,\ldots,\xi_d)^\mathsf T$ have independent identically distributed complex coordinates with $\mathbb E\xi_i=0$, $\mathbb E|\xi_i|^2=1$, and $\mu_4:=\mathbb E|\xi_i|^4<\infty$. Let $A$ be an independent random complex $d\times d$ matrix with $\mathbb E\|A\|_F^2<\infty$, where $\|A\|_F^2:=\sum_{i,j}|A_{ij}|^2$. Put $\tau:=\mathbb E\xi_1^2$. Then
$$\mathbb E\left|\xi^*A\xi-\operatorname{tr}A\right|^2\le C_{\mu_4,\tau}\,\mathbb E\|A\|_F^2,\qquad C_{\mu_4,\tau}:=\max\{\mu_4-1,1+|\tau|^2\}.$$
lem-deformed-mp-fixed-point-solution-is-:
## Statement

Let $c>0$, let $H$ be a Borel probability measure on $[0,\infty)$, and fix $z\in\mathbb C$ with $\operatorname{Im}z>0$. There is at most one $q\in\mathbb C$ satisfying $\operatorname{Im}q>0$, $u:=-(1-c)/z+cq$ with $\operatorname{Im}u>0$, and
$$q=\int_{[0,\infty)}\frac{1}{t(1-c-czq)-z}\,dH(t).$$
lem-hermitian-rank-one-resolvent-update-:
## Statement

Let $B\in\mathbb C^{d\times d}$ be Hermitian positive semidefinite, let $x\in\mathbb C^d$, and let $z=u+i\eta$ with $u\in\mathbb R$ and $\eta>0$. Set $R=(B-zI)^{-1}$ and $R_x=(B+xx^*-zI)^{-1}$. For the trace norm $\|M\|_1$, defined as the sum of the singular values of $M$, one has $1+x^*Rx\ne0$,
$$R_x=R-\frac{Rxx^*R}{1+x^*Rx},\qquad \|R_x-R\|_1\le\frac1\eta,\qquad |\operatorname{tr}R_x-\operatorname{tr}R|\le\frac1\eta.$$
lem-bounded-complex-resolvent-quadratic-:
## Statement

For each positive integer $n$, let $X_n\in\mathbb C^{n\times N_n}$ have entries from one common iid law with mean zero, unit second absolute moment, and absolute value at most $K$, where $K$ is independent of $n$. Let $T_n\in\mathbb C^{n\times n}$ be deterministic Hermitian positive semidefinite with $\|T_n\|_{\mathrm{op}}\le M$, and let $x_n\in\mathbb C^n$ be deterministic with $\|x_n\|_2=1$. Assume $N_n/n\to\kappa\in(0,\infty)$. For fixed $z=u+i\eta$ with $\eta>0$, set
$$A_n:=\frac1{N_n}T_n^{1/2}X_nX_n^*T_n^{1/2},\qquad R_n(z):=(A_n-zI)^{-1}.$$
Then $x_n^*R_n(z)x_n-\mathbb E[x_n^*R_n(z)x_n]\to0$ almost surely. Moreover, for every $t>0$ there is a constant $C=C(K,M,z,\kappa)$ such that, for all sufficiently large $n$,
$$\mathbb P\!\left\{|x_n^*R_n(z)x_n-\mathbb E[x_n^*R_n(z)x_n]|>t\right\}\le\frac{C}{t^4N_n^2}.$$
lem-hermitian-resolvent-trace-concentrat:
## Statement

For each positive integer $n$, let $Y_{n,1},\ldots,Y_{n,N_n}$ be independent random vectors in $\mathbb C^n$, let $B_n=\sum_{j=1}^{N_n}Y_{n,j}Y_{n,j}^*$, and assume $N_n/n\to\kappa\in(0,\infty)$. Fix $z=u+i\eta$ with $u\in\mathbb R$ and $\eta>0$, and define
$$M_n(z):=\frac1n\operatorname{tr}(B_n-zI)^{-1}.$$
Then for every $t>0$,
$$\mathbb P\{|M_n(z)-\mathbb E M_n(z)|>t\}\le4\exp\!\left(-\frac{t^2n^2\eta^2}{4N_n}\right),$$
and $M_n(z)-\mathbb E M_n(z)\to0$ almost surely.
lem-hermitian-spectral-measure-is-probab:
## Statement

For every Hermitian positive semidefinite $A\in\mathbb C^{d\times d}$, its empirical spectral distribution $\mu_A$ is a Borel probability measure supported on $[0,\infty)$. For every deterministic unit vector $x\in\mathbb C^d$, its directional spectral measure $\mu_A^x$ is also a Borel probability measure supported on $[0,\infty)$.
lem-bounded-complex-resolvent-determinis:
## Statement

For each positive integer $n$, let $N_n$ be a positive integer with $N_n/n\to\kappa\in(0,\infty)$, let $X_n\in\mathbb C^{n\times N_n}$ have entries from one common iid law with mean zero, second absolute moment one and $|X_{ij}|\le K$ almost surely for a fixed $K$, and let $T_n$ be deterministic Hermitian positive semidefinite (self-adjoint with $v^*T_nv\ge0$ for every $v$) with induced Euclidean operator norm $\|T_n\|_{\mathrm{op}}\le M$. Define
$$A_n=N_n^{-1}T_n^{1/2}X_nX_n^*T_n^{1/2},\qquad \widetilde A_n=N_n^{-1}X_n^*T_nX_n,$$
$$R_n(z)=(A_n-zI_n)^{-1},\qquad \widetilde R_n(z)=(\widetilde A_n-zI_{N_n})^{-1},\qquad q_n(z)=\mathbb E\left[N_n^{-1}\operatorname{tr}\widetilde R_n(z)\right].$$
For every fixed $z=u+i\eta$ with $u\in\mathbb R$ and $\eta>0$, the matrix $I_n+q_n(z)T_n$ is invertible and
$$\sup_{\|x\|_2=1}\left|x^*\left(\mathbb E R_n(z)+\frac1z(I_n+q_n(z)T_n)^{-1}\right)x\right|\longrightarrow0.$$
thm-general-population-sample-covariance:
## Statement

Assume the Axiom of Choice. For each positive integer $n$, let $N_n$ be a positive integer with $N_n/n\to\kappa\in(0,\infty)$, let $X_n\in\mathbb C^{n\times N_n}$ have entries from one common iid law with mean zero, second absolute moment one and absolute value bounded by one fixed finite constant, and let $T_n$ be deterministic Hermitian positive semidefinite (self-adjoint with $v^*T_nv\ge0$ for every $v$) with uniformly bounded induced Euclidean operator norm. Suppose the empirical eigenvalue measures $H_n=n^{-1}\sum_{i=1}^n\delta_{\lambda_i(T_n)}$ converge weakly to a Borel probability measure $H$ on $[0,\infty)$. Put $c=\kappa^{-1}$ and $A_n=N_n^{-1}T_n^{1/2}X_nX_n^*T_n^{1/2}$, and let $F_n=n^{-1}\sum_{i=1}^n\delta_{\lambda_i(A_n)}$. Then there is a unique Borel probability measure $F_{c,H}$ on $[0,\infty)$ such that, almost surely, $F_n$ converges weakly to $F_{c,H}$. Its Stieltjes transform $m_{c,H}(z)=\int(t-z)^{-1}\,dF_{c,H}(t)$ is the unique $m\in\mathbb C$ satisfying $\operatorname{Im}m>0$, $u:=-(1-c)/z+cm$ with $\operatorname{Im}u>0$, and
$$m=\int_{[0,\infty)}\frac{1}{t(1-c-czm)-z}\,dH(t)\qquad(\operatorname{Im}z>0).$$
thm-directional-sample-covariance-resolv:
## Statement

Assume the Axiom of Choice. For each positive integer $n$, let $N_n$ be a positive integer with $N_n/n\to\kappa\in(0,\infty)$, let $X_n\in\mathbb C^{n\times N_n}$ have entries from one common iid law with mean zero, second absolute moment one and absolute value bounded by a fixed finite constant, and let $T_n$ be deterministic Hermitian positive semidefinite (self-adjoint with $v^*T_nv\ge0$ for every $v$) with uniformly bounded induced Euclidean operator norm and empirical eigenvalue measures $H_n=n^{-1}\sum_i\delta_{\lambda_i(T_n)}\Rightarrow H$. Let $x_n\in\mathbb C^n$ be deterministic unit vectors such that for every $w\in\mathbb C\setminus[0,\infty)$,
$$x_n^*(T_n-wI_n)^{-1}x_n\longrightarrow m_H(w):=\int_{[0,\infty)}(t-w)^{-1}\,dH(t).$$
For $A_n=N_n^{-1}T_n^{1/2}X_nX_n^*T_n^{1/2}$, define the directional spectral measure $\mu_n^{x_n}(B)=x_n^*\mathbf1_B(A_n)x_n$ for Borel $B\subseteq[0,\infty)$. Then almost surely $\mu_n^{x_n}\Rightarrow F_{c,H}$, where $c=\kappa^{-1}$ and $F_{c,H}$ is the probability measure characterized by
$$m_{c,H}(z)=\int_{[0,\infty)}\frac{1}{t(1-c-czm_{c,H}(z))-z}\,dH(t),\qquad \operatorname{Im}z>0.$$
lem-complex-sample-covariance-norm-bound:
## Statement

Let $(\xi_{ij})_{i,j\ge1}$ be one infinite iid array of centered complex random variables with $\mathbb E|\xi_{11}|^2=\tau^2<\infty$ and $\mathbb E|\xi_{11}|^4<\infty$. For positive integers $n$, let $N_n$ be positive with $n/N_n\to c\in(0,\infty)$, and let $X_n=(\xi_{ij})_{1\le i\le n,\,1\le j\le N_n}$. Then almost surely
$$\limsup_{n\to\infty}\frac{\|X_n\|_{\mathrm{op}}}{\sqrt{N_n}}\le(\sigma_R+\sigma_I)(1+\sqrt c),\qquad \sigma_R^2=\mathbb E(\operatorname{Re}\xi_{11})^2,\quad \sigma_I^2=\mathbb E(\operatorname{Im}\xi_{11})^2.$$
In particular, when $\tau^2=1$, the right side is at most $\sqrt2(1+\sqrt c)$.
thm-directional-sample-covariance-resolv:
## Statement

Assume the Axiom of Choice. Let $(\xi_{ij})_{i,j\ge1}$ be one infinite iid array of complex random variables with $\mathbb E\xi_{11}=0$, $\mathbb E|\xi_{11}|^2=1$, and $\mathbb E|\xi_{11}|^4<\infty$. For each positive integer $n$, let $N_n$ be positive with $n/N_n\to c\in(0,\infty)$ and let $X_n=(\xi_{ij})_{1\le i\le n,\,1\le j\le N_n}$ be its upper-left block. Let $T_n$ be deterministic Hermitian positive semidefinite with uniformly bounded operator norm and empirical eigenvalue measures $H_n=n^{-1}\sum_i\delta_{\lambda_i(T_n)}\Rightarrow H$. Let $x_n\in\mathbb C^n$ be deterministic unit vectors such that, for every $w\in\mathbb C\setminus[0,\infty)$,
$$x_n^*(T_n-wI_n)^{-1}x_n\longrightarrow m_H(w):=\int_{[0,\infty)}(t-w)^{-1}\,dH(t).$$
Define $A_n=N_n^{-1}T_n^{1/2}X_nX_n^*T_n^{1/2}$ and $\mu_n^{x_n}(B)=x_n^*\mathbf1_B(A_n)x_n$ for Borel $B\subseteq[0,\infty)$. Then almost surely $\mu_n^{x_n}$ converges weakly to the probability measure $F_{c,H}$ whose Stieltjes transform is the unique $m\in\mathbb C$ satisfying $\operatorname{Im}m>0$, $u=-(1-c)/z+cm$ with $\operatorname{Im}u>0$, and
$$m=\int_{[0,\infty)}\frac{1}{t(1-c-czm)-z}\,dH(t),\qquad \operatorname{Im}z>0.$$
cor-isotropic-minimum-norm-risk-closure-:
## Statement

Assume the Axiom of Choice. Let $(\xi_{ij})_{i,j\ge1}$ be one infinite iid array of real random variables with mean zero, variance one and finite fourth moment. For each $n$, let $p_n$ be a positive integer with $p_n/n\to\gamma\in(0,\infty)\setminus\{1\}$ and let $X_n=(\xi_{ij})_{1\le i\le n,\,1\le j\le p_n}$ be the upper-left block. Let $\beta_n\in\mathbb R^{p_n}$ be deterministic with $\|\beta_n\|_2=r>0$. Let $\varepsilon_n\in\mathbb R^n$ have independent centered components of variance $\sigma^2$, independent of $X_n$ (so its covariance is $\sigma^2I_n$), and let $z_{0,n}\in\mathbb R^{p_n}$ be independent of $(X_n,\varepsilon_n)$ with mean zero and covariance  $I_{p_n}$. Set $y_n=X_n\beta_n+\varepsilon_n$, $\widehat\beta_n=X_n^+y_n$, and $S_n=X_n^{\mathsf T}X_n/n$. Define the design-conditional prediction risk by $\mathcal R_n=\mathbb E_{\varepsilon_n,z_{0,n}}[(z_{0,n}^{\mathsf T}\widehat\beta_n-z_{0,n}^{\mathsf T}\beta_n)^2\mid X_n]$. If $\gamma<1$, then almost surely $\mathcal R_n\to\sigma^2\gamma/(1-\gamma)$. If $\gamma>1$, then almost surely $\mathcal R_n\to r^2(1-1/\gamma)+\sigma^2/(\gamma-1)$.
cor-negative-axis-directional-resolvent-:
## Statement

Under the hypotheses of the sample-covariance resolvent deterministic-equivalent theorem, for each fixed $s>0$ the directional measures satisfy
$$\int_{[0,\infty)}\frac{1}{t+s}\,d\mu_n^{x_n}(t)\longrightarrow\int_{[0,\infty)}\frac{1}{t+s}\,dF_{c,H}(t)\quad\text{almost surely}.$$
